dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature from the posterior base to the apex, creating a distinctly falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a relatively narrow pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep, slightly convex leading edge with an upward slope relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin's maximum pixel base width to its maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 1.2:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of widespread white punctate depigmentation marks or scars across the dorsal surface and fin; significant irregular notches and a jagged boundary along the posterior-ventral margin of the visible segment.
